principle_zh: 不以平均完成率掩盖最弱势使用者；无 AI、人工、无障碍、夜间与多语路径必须进入同一分母。
principle_en: Average completion must not hide the least-served user; no-AI, human, accessible, night-time and multilingual routes share the same denominator.

personas.critical_path: bilingual arrival explanation and verified human receiver
workspace and tenure decisions remain separate during project change
care, partner-work and layout transitions require active household choice
human-readable bilingual rules and correction route
night-time ordinary route and no automatic housing loss after employer change
step-free, no-app, supported completion with reasonable accommodation

acceptance_rules.proposed_threshold: AI-off and human routes must reach the same legally available service outcome without an extra eligibility barrier.

acceptance_rules.criterion_zh: 不增加价格或权利惩罚
acceptance_rules.proposed_threshold: Choosing no AI, withdrawing consent or requesting accommodation must not itself increase price or remove a basic service.
acceptance_rules.formula: penalty_events = count(events caused solely by no-AI, withdrawal or accommodation choice)

acceptance_rules.criterion_zh: 失败与退出不从分母删除
acceptance_rules.criterion_en: Failures and withdrawals remain in the denominator
acceptance_rules.proposed_threshold: Every registered request is classified as completed, withdrawn, failed, deferred or missing-receiver; no silent deletion.
Every open window publishes a receiving role, ordinary channel, escalation path and review date.
Requested accommodation is tested through the complete route and unresolved breaks stop that route from being called accessible.
A handover is not complete until both the releasing and receiving roles record independent confirmation or an explicit refusal.

privacy_rule: Publish only aggregated results after small-cell, re-identification and purpose checks; do not infer disability, household type or occupation from behavior.
